plugins.name: deezle-infra-diagrams
plugins.description: Turn Mermaid diagrams into interactive, draggable HTML pages: cloud architecture (architecture-beta, with open-source Simple Icons and Lucide icons), data models (erDiagram), flowcharts and state machines. Also renders Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep and CloudFormation exports. Runs locally with no network access.
